item.title: Panic Attack or Heart Problem? What to Know
item.description: Panic attacks and heart problems can feel surprisingly alike, and many people's first panic attack ends with a trip to the ER. Our new article explains the common differences, when to call 911, and what to do next if your heart checks out. Telehealth visits are available for teens and adults anywhere in Washington.
